brief: A 6-second logo reveal for a studio called Flux: abstract shapes gather and morph into the wordmark "FLUX", which holds at the end.
notes: Weakest was finish/motion: on Blobs A and C the entrance fade and the drift keyframes overlapped and the drift also overlapped the exit fade, so two clips fought the same movement — I split each fade down to a 0.3 s helper and shortened each drift so the in-fade (0–0.3 s / 0.2–0.5 s), drift and out-fade at 2.7 s never overlap. The tagline measured ~8 px (fontSize 2.2) and its box at y 62 collided with the 18-unit FLUX wordmark at 4.92 s and 5.76 s, so I raised it to 4.5 (4× the headline, readable) with brighter #cbb8e6, moved it to y 66 and lifted FLUX to y 42 to open an 11-unit gap. I also varied Blob B's entrance (zoom in from 1.2, the hero that becomes the logo) so the three shapes no longer enter with identical fades.
